outcome: risk factors for newborns with temperatures less than 36.4degC 30 minutes after the bath
cohort: Healthy, term infants after vaginal delivery were included, with 200 participants in the skin-to-skin rewarming group and 200 in the radiant rewarming group, though the skin-to-skin group was stopped early with 96 participants due to overwhelming maternal preference.
finding: Mothers overwhelmingly preferred skin-to-skin rewarming, and newborns can safely rewarm skin-to-skin if staff pay special attention to positioning and frequent rechecking of mother and newborn.
